_about: What the opening take's model happened to write, remarked on where it is read (build_storyboard.py, OPENING_NOTES). Rewritten for each retake of the opening. Take: build/rec_opening3.
m2_intent: Look at the end of that line: the mind repeats part of its own instructions, to let things feel half-familiar without naming a memory it does not hold. A small model sometimes echoes what it was told. Read it as this mind reminding itself not to invent.
m3_intent: The acting mind reaches for a poignant flavour of summer rather than a blade. It does not matter: the act is still remembering something sharp, and the code knows what that memory holds.
m4_intent: Something comes back, yes, it was that: this mind is remembering already, while it says what it will try.
m5_intent: Here the acting mind reaches for something soft and warm, the very opposite of this memory. Read it as a child's wishful thinking: what comes back has no shelter at all.
m5_outcome: And notice that the text says it failed. It did not: in childhood remembering always succeeds, and the memory is given all the same. When the words and the rules disagree, the rules win.
up_reason: Tide Watching reads getting up as a tide: the flats will hold for another hour, then comes the turn. That is what a persona does: the same question, put to a different mind, comes back in its own voice.
up_intent: Endurance has an odd plan: rest here until its strength fails, then press on. A mind made for endurance plans to outlast itself.
